newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-PENGUINS ROOKIE LALIME NAMED PLAYER OF THE WEEK.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-PENGUINS ROOKIE LALIME NAMED PLAYER OF THE WEEK.

text.p: Pittsburgh Penguins rookie goaltender Patrick Lalime, who has launched his career with a league-best 15 decisions without a loss, was named NHL Player of the Week on Tuesday.
Lalime went 2-0 with a .984 save percentage and one shutout for the Penguins last week, who are 16-2-2 in their last 20 games and lead the Northeast Division with a 25-15-5 record.
Lalime stopped 30 shots in a 3-1 win over the Central Divison-leading Dallas Stars on Tuesday. The next night, he made 31 saves for his third shutout in a 3-0 win over the Hartford Whalers.

Lalime, 13-0-2, leads the league with a 1.81 goals against average and .940 save percentage. His streak of 15 decisions without a loss to start his career is one better than those of Montreal's Ken Dryden (12-0-2) and Boston's Ross Brooks (11-0-3).
